references.text: The same instruction to make a gold crown around the table for the showbread, which shows the repeated pattern of gold crowns on holy objects.
The incense altar was also to have a gold crown around it, the same decorative element as on the ark of the covenant.
Fulfilling the command to cover the ark with pure gold inside and out, and to make a gold crown around it.
Solomon's temple had the innermost room lined with pure gold, where the ark of the covenant was placed, and the ark itself was covered with gold.
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the ark of the covenant as being covered with gold on all sides, confirming the Old Testament description.
